answer: A Hardware security key bound by DNS record proof with revocation on transfer ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the hardware security key answers a fresh challenge, the DNS record proof is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A lone crystal cannot fake a channel; only the bound record counts. From the echo to the pearl, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
